$comment: The Booth, Kronk's music space, as its own music entry (Cassidy, 11 Nov 2026: Kronk is a digital collaboration; the Booth is music). Facts from projects/kronk-booth/README.md and the Kronk entry. Kronk is run by Tal; sharing permission confirmed by Cassidy, 9 Nov 2026.
title: Kronk Booth
description: The Booth, Kronk's stage for music. Cassidy has helped build it with Tal.
portfolioDescription: The Booth is Kronk's stage for music, with DJ sets, mixes, tracks, albums, readings and live sets. It plays music made by members and credits who made it.
role: Contributor. Cassidy built the Booth tidy (#2127, merged 13 Oct 2026) and live sets and listening tools (#2339, merged 23 Oct 2026: My sets, saves, kinds, sort, play next, Remind me, Shoutouts, First listens and a live banner). More Booth work is in progress.

images.alt: The Booth in the Kronk tour, with example data: a live banner for a made-up member's set above the Musik grid of example sets with play and save buttons.
A set's page in the Booth tour: credits, a track list, Play next and Shoutouts, with example data.
The Booth's Live sets in the tour: a made-up live set to listen in to, and coming-up sets with Remind me.
The Booth's Musik page on Kronk: a grid of sets and mixes with cover art, including My Living YOUlogy and Lavender Skies by Cassidy Rae, and Waiting For A Ride by Cassidy Rae ft Taylah Mayne.
